task_completion.description: Log in to the Nx Witness Desktop Client as admin.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Nx Witness interface is visible, showing the resource tree on the left and the 'admin' user logged in.

task_completion.description: Create a new layout and name it 'Warehouse Map'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A new tab or layout entry in the resource tree is visible with the exact name 'Warehouse Map'.

task_completion.description: Set the floor plan 'warehouse_plan.png' as the layout background.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The layout viewing area displays the warehouse floor plan image instead of a blank grid.

task_completion.description: Place the 'Entrance Camera' at the bottom center of the map.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A camera icon labeled 'Entrance Camera' is positioned at the bottom-middle section of the warehouse floor plan.

task_completion.description: Place the 'Server Room Camera' at the top right of the map.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A camera icon labeled 'Server Room Camera' is positioned in the upper-right corner of the warehouse floor plan.
The 'Save' button is clicked, or the layout tab no longer shows an unsaved changes indicator (like an asterisk).

integrity.description: The agent used the Nx Witness GUI to configure the map rather than CLI scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Nx Witness layout editor and dragging camera resources.

integrity.description: The agent navigated to the correct file path for the background image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file picker dialog is seen navigating to /home/ga/Documents/ to select warehouse_plan.png.

integrity.description: The agent used existing camera resources from the tree rather than creating dummy text labels.
integrity.visual_evidence: The items on the map are camera entities dragged from the 'Cameras' list in the resource tree.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The layout must be named 'Warehouse Map'. The background image is 'warehouse_plan.png' located in /home/ga/Documents/. There are two specific cameras to place: 'Entrance Camera' (bottom center) and 'Server Room Camera' (top right). The credentials for the client are admin/Admin1234!.
